_meta.note: Coarse (章節) skeleton for the 11 一階 subjects, transcribed faithfully from the official 考選部 命題大綱 (see moex-blueprint.txt in this dir, the raw PDF extraction). This is the top level of the closed concept tree per add-neurons-concept-tags §1.1. Fine (leaf) concepts hang under these chapters in §1.3 (concept-vocab/<subject>.ts). Chapter `id` is a stable canonical slug unique within its subject; `subjectId` matches the corpus `question.subject` value verbatim.
